Dear Filomena,
Thank you for contacting eMobility Support.
After checking the logs, we can see that there was a network error with the OCPP.
The network seemed unstable, and this is why no actions could be provided from the backend of the charger.
Right now the chargers seems to have no errors and the connection with OCPP and SCB are stable.
Please provide us with feedback, so we can close this ticket, or let me know if the issue occurred again recently.
Thank you.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum
